black.comment: bg--black* section fill. 4.x: background-color: variables.$secondary (_background-mixins.scss:9,14,19,24) = var(--brand-secondary) — a brand channel, NOT flat black; a flat alias here would re-ship the Buttons grayscale bug at section scale.

gray.comment: bg--gray* section fill. 4.x: variables.$light -> var(--uids-light) -> gray/100 — a legacy core alias, not a brand channel; flat.

white.comment: bg--white* section fill. 4.x: variables.$white = the literal #fff (_variables.scss:29); flat.

default.comment: The --transparent-border role (uids-core.scss:32): default subtle border on light/ambient backgrounds. Consumers: @mixin border (_utilities.scss:193-199), .media--border (_media.scss:4), the background system's gray/white/gold/brain override (_background.scss:43-49), and the list-group rules (_utilities.scss:276,279).

on-dark.comment: Border color inside [class*='bg--black'] ancestors — the border mixin's override (_utilities.scss:196-198) and _background.scss:51-55's matching selector block. Minted in the border-foundation commit for the background foundation's _background.scss:54 swap to consume.

text.comment: 4.x: color: variables.$secondary for type 'light' (_background-mixins.scss:104, bg-fg-colors mixin) — applies to gold/gray/white backgrounds.
4.x: color: variables.$white for type 'dark' (_background-mixins.scss:111); $white is the literal #fff (_variables.scss:29), not $primary/$secondary — stays FLAT, no brandChannel.
